description: Hasebroekstraat 56-70 (1915): orange-red brick fronts of a narrow and a wide axis, mirrored in pairs; a white painted bay window stack on the top two storeys of the wide axis over a white-framed triple window, glazed tile diamonds between patterned brick courses beside the bays, red house doors at the outer party walls, a thin white eaves over a red-tile roof front with dormers

match.note: the 1915 Hasebroekstraat rows; the white bay stack on one side is the tell (match.mirrorForAccent); 52-54 (5.4-5.6 m, the older balcony type with a 1915 BAG year) fall outside the width fit; 2026-10-16 (2): the bay is read by width relative to the pand's own wall (Hasebroekstraat 53-67 and 56-70: 2.1-2.3 m on the 2024-12-11 strip), not by the exposure-dependent accent share (Van Effenstraat 7D read 0.49 with no bay)

eaves.note: thin white eaves; the low red-tile roof face and the set-back dormers stay out of the model (a 70 degree mansard face drew a 2.7 m red wall the photo does not show)

door-left.note: red door at the left party wall (68, 64, 60, 56 seen from the street)

rhythm.bays: a narrow and a wide axis (the wide one the bay stack)
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the bays meet at one party wall, the doors at the next
rhythm.groundFloor: red house door at the outer party wall, a wide window under the bay
rhythm.roofline: thin white eaves, red tiles, dormers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 1-8: mirrored pairs of narrow + bay axes, yellow tile diamonds between dark checkered courses on storeys 1 and 3

schemaLimits: the bay windows are drawn as square-cornered boxes; the photo's are segmental in plan
